title: Universal and Parameter-free Gradient Sliding for Composite Optimization
summary: We propose a Parameter-Free Universal Gradient Sliding (PFUGS) algorithm for computing an approximate solution to the convex composite optimization $\min_{x\in X} \{f(x) + g(x)\}$, where $f$ has $(M_ν,ν)$-Hölder continuous subgradient and $g$ has $L$-Lipschitz continuous gradient. PFUGS computes an $\varepsilon$-approximate solution with $\mathcal{O}((M_ν/\varepsilon)^{{2}/{(1+3ν)}})$ evaluations of (sub)gradients of $f$ and $\mathcal{O}((L/\varepsilon)^{1/2})$ evaluations of gradients of $g$, without prior knowledge of problem constants.
